Tests that LLM max_concurrency is accepted independently of the extraction thread budget

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput, ExtractionConfig, ExtractInputKind

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), mime_type="text/plain", uri="https://example.com/text/report.txt")
    config = ExtractionConfig(captioning={"llm": {"max_concurrency": 2, "model": "openai/gpt-4o"}, "min_image_area": 1000}, concurrency={"max_threads": 8})
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
```
